missions.title: Read the Structure
missions.description: Complete 3 basic Higher High (HH), Higher Low (HL), Lower High (LH), and Lower Low (LL) swing challenges in the Market Academy or Structure Observatory.

dialogue.offered: Welcome to Market Arena! An isolated candlestick tells you almost nothing. You must look at swing points—Higher Highs and Higher Lows. Head to the Academy or Observatory and identify 3 swing formations.
dialogue.in_progress: Observe how each peak and trough relates to the previous one. Complete 3 swing identification drills.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Superb eye! You've learned to mark swing points accurately across developing price movements. Claim your World XP!
dialogue.completed: You have mastered foundational swing identification. Talk to Structure Analyst next to interpret trending sequences.

missions.title: Find the Trend
missions.description: Correctly classify 5 simulated market environments as Uptrend, Downtrend, or Sideways in the Trend Stadium.

dialogue.offered: Market condition dictates trading strategy. Enter the Trend Stadium and classify 5 market environments correctly: Uptrends (HH+HL), Downtrends (LH+LL), and Sideways consolidation.
dialogue.in_progress: Inspect the scenario chambers in Trend Stadium. Reach 5 accurate trend classifications.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Outstanding analytical accuracy! You can instantly spot whether a market is trending or consolidating. Claim your reward!
dialogue.completed: Trend direction verified. Always align your directional bias with dominant market structure.

missions.title: Structure Sequence
missions.description: Complete 5 structure-sequence challenges in the Structure Lab.

dialogue.offered: Price moves in structured waves. In the Structure Lab, decode 5 sequences such as HH -> HL -> HH -> HL or LH -> LL -> LH -> LL to determine when a trend continues or shifts.
dialogue.in_progress: Continue solving sequence chains in the Structure Lab. Reach 5 verified solutions.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Sequence mastery confirmed! You understand how consecutive swing points construct macro trends.
dialogue.completed: You have mastered multi-wave structure sequences. Keep watching for structural breaks.

missions.title: Range Detector
missions.description: Correctly identify 5 simulated range and consolidation environments.

dialogue.offered: Markets spend over 70% of their time consolidating between support and resistance boundaries without establishing new highs or lows. Identify 5 range structures.
dialogue.in_progress: Look for equal highs and equal lows where neither buyers nor sellers can push price into new territory.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Range recognition verified! You won't get trapped looking for a trend in a consolidating market.
dialogue.completed: Range detection complete! You know when to wait for a breakout rather than forcing trend trades.

missions.title: Breakout Test
missions.description: Complete 5 simulated breakout and rejection scenarios in the Breakout / Fakeout Zone.

dialogue.offered: When price approaches key structural boundaries, it either breaks out with sustained volume or rejects violently. Enter the Breakout Zone and solve 5 boundary scenarios.
dialogue.in_progress: Analyze the candle closes outside key structural levels in the Breakout Zone. Reach 5 confirmed outcomes.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Breakout verification complete! You understand confirmation versus immediate rejection.
dialogue.completed: Never chase a breakout without waiting for structural confirmation.

missions.title: Fakeout Hunter
missions.description: Complete 5 fakeout recognition scenarios to master liquidity traps and false breakouts.

dialogue.offered: The most dangerous price action is the fakeout—a candle wick spikes past a structural high only to immediately collapse back into the range. Spot 5 fakeout traps in the Breakout Zone.
dialogue.in_progress: Detect false breakouts where wicks pierce key levels but body closes fail to follow through.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Trap detection verified! You have developed the patience to avoid chasing false breakouts.
dialogue.completed: You are a certified Fakeout Hunter! You know how to identify liquidity grabs.

missions.title: Chart Theater
missions.description: Complete one sequential playback session in the Chart Theater with pause, identification, and reveal.

dialogue.offered: Step into the Chart Theater in the southwest quarter. Watch candles develop live, pause at the critical structural inflection point, identify the market state, and reveal historical confirmation.
dialogue.in_progress: Enter the Chart Theater pavilion and complete a full sequential playback scenario.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Theater session completed! Experiencing structure develop in real-time builds true market instincts.
dialogue.completed: Chart Theater logged! Revisit anytime to observe diverse market scenarios unfold.

missions.title: Market Blitz
missions.description: Complete one full 10-round match in the Market Blitz Arena under countdown pressure.

dialogue.offered: Put your market structure reflexes to the test! Step into the Market Blitz Arena in the northeast sector and clear all 10 procedural rounds.
dialogue.in_progress: The Market Blitz Arena awaits. Complete all 10 rounds of Swings, Trends, Sequences, Breakouts, and Fakeouts.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Match finished! You maintained rapid precision across all 10 procedural rounds. Claim your reward!
dialogue.completed: Blitz match logged! Replay anytime to push your combo multiplier and Market Structure Mastery to 100%.

missions.title: City Explorer
missions.description: Physically navigate Market Arena and interact with 6 unique facilities, observatories, and arenas.

dialogue.offered: Get familiar with the metropolis of structure! Visit Market Academy, Structure Observatory, Structure Lab, Trend Stadium, Breakout Zone, and Chart Theater.
dialogue.in_progress: Walk the avenues of Market Arena! Check in at all major learning facilities and arenas to map out the district.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: District mapped! You have explored every corner of Market Arena. Claim your Pioneer commendation.
dialogue.completed: You know the entire district layout. Use each facility regularly to hone your market structure instincts.

missions.title: Market Structure Master
missions.description: Complete the advanced comprehensive trial combining swing analysis, trend transitions, breakouts, and fakeout recognition.

dialogue.offered: This is the final trial of Market Arena. You must combine swing identification, trend transitions, range breakouts, and fakeout defenses in a comprehensive multi-step trial.
dialogue.in_progress: Visit the Market Mentor terminal in Market Plaza or the Market Scenario Arena to execute the full trial.
dialogue.ready_to_claim: Mastery trial passed with flying colors! You have conquered market structure and the flow of price.
dialogue.completed: You are an officially certified Market Structure Master of Strativo World. Wear your title with pride!
